name: Doorbell
description: A probe. It asks whether an ordinary app can make the watch say something to the phone at a moment of the wearer's choosing, by sending the kernel the same end-of-activity message a workout app sends and watching the BLE link for what comes out. Three clicks of the top-right button write a small command file and ring; the other buttons ring without a file, ring through the service instead of the screen, and ring three times in a row.
